reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Clear spec deviation: util_rate = debt / (debt + cash - cash_reserve) exceeds 1 when cash_reserve > cash; reserve.move:143 grows cash_reserve unboundedly with no guard. Attack path: an attacker drives utilization to ~100% via borrowing, then any subsequent market interaction triggers accrue_interest, advancing cash_reserve toward (and past) the cash balance — at that point the interest model enters a runaway regime producing rates above max_borrow_rate. Attack path is plausible but exploitability is uncertain because sustained near-100% utilization requires no deposits or repayments for an extended period; interest rate manipulation is an explicit focus area per scope.
